shared_elements: standing human figure in frontal/upright posture
figure holding an object in an extended arm
human figure with head, two arms and two legs
justification: Both depict upright human figures, and in each case at least one figure extends an arm holding an object (a weapon-like hafted item in B, staffs/vessels in A), but that is a near-universal motif. A shows a dense processional frieze of naturalistically modelled, robed, bearded figures in profile between rosette borders, while B shows a single isolated, radically schematic stick-like figure with no border, costume or attendant detail.
